defects.title: Apply the donor-first hierarchy across every landing surface
defects.body: Premise: the public-route migration changes destinations but leaves the navigation, primary CTA, DOM band order, and quick-access order scholarship-first. → Path: a visitor reaches the landing page and follows the first visible action or the page content sequence. → Verdict: the required donor-first experience is not delivered: the primary navigation/hero CTA still sends visitors to `/solicitar-bolsa`, the scholarship band precedes the benefactor band, and quick access also places scholarship first.
evidence: Premise: app/page.tsx:397-405 retains `Solicitar bolsa` before `Seja um benfeitor` and makes `/solicitar-bolsa` the nav CTA → Path: the landing page's primary navigation is rendered → Verdict: its primary route remains scholarship rather than donor.
app/page.tsx:423-425 → the hero's only direct public CTA is `Faça sua solicitação de bolsa` to `/solicitar-bolsa`.
app/page.tsx:518-573 → the scholarship section is rendered before the benefactor section in DOM order.
app/page.tsx:636-637 → quick access lists the scholarship form before `Seja um benfeitor`.

.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_04.md:103-107 → requires benefactor before scholarship in navigation, content bands, and quick access, and primary navigation/hero CTAs to target `/seja-um-benfeitor`.

defects.title: Move the scholarship public shell to the canonical route
defects.body: Premise: `/form` now permanently redirects, while its route-local layout still owns the scholarship shell and its inline legacy seal; Next route layouts do not wrap sibling `/solicitar-bolsa` segments. → Path: a visitor follows any canonical scholarship link. → Verdict: `/solicitar-bolsa` renders only the form/unavailable component without the back link, explanatory header, or approved web seal, while the obsolete inline seal remains stranded on the redirect route. This breaks the canonical public-page and shared-seal migration together.
evidence: Premise: app/solicitar-bolsa/page.tsx:7-9 returns ScholarshipForm or FormUnavailableMessage directly → Path: the canonical route is requested → Verdict: no layout from the sibling `app/form` segment is part of its route tree.
app/form/page.tsx:1-5 → the old page permanently redirects, so it cannot render the canonical route's content under its own layout.
app/form/layout.tsx:10-28 and :29-118 → the missing shell contains the public header/navigation and an inline SVG rather than SealLogo.
.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_04.md:64-77 → canonical public routes must provide the public experience and every web surface must use the approved shared seal.
